space.$description: CLASSIFICATION: DERIVED. A generic rem-based micro-scale for intra-component spacing (padding inside a card, gap between a label and its value). It is NOT the page rhythm — see space.gap / space.section below, which carry the measured reference geometry. Retained because 19 components already build on it; not deprecated.

gap.$description: CLASSIFICATION: MEASURED. Ported verbatim from the reference template's own rhythm utilities (assets/css/main.css .gspace-0..5 and .gspace-100), per CLIENT_REQ_012 / EV-20260826-032. These are the page-level rhythm gaps between and within sections. The 100px step is the template's dominant section-internal gap (.about-wrapper, .community-grid, .team-content-wrapper, .banner-home-top all use it) and has no equivalent in the rem micro-scale above — its absence was the structural cause of prior builds reading as compact.

section.$description: CLASSIFICATION: MEASURED. Reference .section padding (120px block / 20px inline) and .section-wrapper inset padding with its two responsive step-downs (30px -> 20px at <=1025px -> 10px at <=767px). Ported per CLIENT_REQ_012.

banner.$description: CLASSIFICATION: MEASURED. Reference .section-banner-inner padding (230px top / 120px bottom) — the inner-page title banner. The large top value clears the fixed header and is what gives inner pages their characteristic proportion.
